An '''iron shovel''' is a [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]] of the [[Iron equipment|iron]] tier, crafted from an [[iron ingot]] and two sticks. At speed 8 it digs faster than the iron pickaxe or axe mine.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Digging ===
It breaks shovel blocks at speed 8 and has 500 durability, and it collects snowballs from snow.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4.5}} damage at an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a single iron ingot, and at a [[smithing table]] it takes [[steel alloy]] to become its [[Steel equipment|steel]] counterpart.
